label: Productivity
blurb: Productivity of the water column and the carbon it delivers to the deep seafloor.

headlines.label: Provisional productivity score
headlines.note: The score is the mean of this pillar's variable percentiles among EBSAs, from 0 to 100.

charts.title: Percentile by variable
charts.subtitle: Percentiles run from 0 to 100 among all EBSAs, and higher is better for the pillar.

charts.title: Distribution across EBSAs
charts.subtitle: The dot marks this EBSA's value on the spread of all EBSAs.
charts.label: label

method: Phytoplankton carbon is the Bio-ORACLE v3 depth-mean for the 2000–2020 baseline, in mmol per m³. Carbon flux to the seafloor is the NEMO-MEDUSA decadal mean for 2006–2015, in mmol C per m² per day. Both are area-weighted means over the EBSA's res-6 cells. Both are strongly skewed, so the strip uses a log scale; the percentile is unaffected. Scores are mid-rank percentiles (0–100) among the EBSAs with data, with direction applied so higher is better for the pillar; tied values share the midpoint of their rank range. The pillar score is the plain mean of the variable percentiles. All of this is provisional.
